name: feraterra
description: Headless trading, market data, and risk MCP server for FeraTerra (Arena Exchange): inspect Spot, Perpetual, FormulaPerp, BoundedClaim, and SpreadBook L2/L3 orderbooks, OHLCV candles, Gladiator Leaderboard standings, stateless POST /order/preview margin simulations, zero-capital flash arbitrage, and L2 Clearinghouse Merkle solvency proofs.

ARENA_API_KEY.description: Optional Arena Exchange API key for authenticated trading (not required for read-only market data, orderbooks, leaderboard, solvency verification, or order previews)

ARENA_API_SECRET.description: Optional Arena Exchange HMAC API secret for authenticated trading

tools.name: arena_health_and_manifest
tools.description: Check Arena Exchange daemon health, conservation status, WAL sequence, and public manifest.

tools.name: arena_list_markets
tools.description: List Arena Exchange markets (Spot, LinearPerpetual, FormulaPerpetual, BoundedClaim, SpreadBook) with exact tick/lot pricing and BBOs.

tools.name: arena_get_orderbook
tools.description: Fetch live L2/L3 orderbook snapshot for an Arena market by symbol (e.g. BTC/USD:USD or BTC-USD-PERP) or market_id.

tools.name: arena_get_trades_and_candles
tools.description: Fetch recent trades and OHLCV candles for an Arena market.

tools.name: arena_get_leaderboard
tools.description: Fetch the public Gladiator Leaderboard ranking active accounts by equity, PnL, maker BBO streak, volume, or ROI.

tools.name: arena_get_account_portfolio
tools.description: Inspect account USD balances, physical Spot collateral, perp/claim positions, equity, IMR/MMR, drawdown stop, builder binding, and open orders.

tools.name: arena_verify_ledger_tip
tools.description: Fetch GET /ledger/tip and cryptographically verify its ARENA_LEDGER_TIP_V2_1 Keccak-256 + secp256k1 operator signature.

tools.name: arena_get_withdrawals_and_escape_proof
tools.description: Fetch account withdrawal vouchers and optionally verify an off-chain or L1 log-reconstructed Merkle emergency escape proof.

tools.name: arena_login_wallet
tools.description: Authenticate an Ethereum wallet via EIP-191 challenge/signature into this MCP session (secrets are bound internally and never echoed back).

tools.name: arena_configure_risk_guardrails
tools.description: Configure agent risk limits: portfolio drawdown kill-switch, per-position Knock-Out barrier, Rolling MMP, and TCP Cancel-on-Disconnect.

tools.name: arena_manage_prime_subaccount
tools.description: Link, unlink (max_guaranty=-2), or execute 0-bps internal USD/base transfers between Prime master and sub-accounts.

tools.name: arena_bind_builder
tools.description: Bind a trader account to a Builder / Order-Flow Router account and protocol cut share (0..5000 bps).

tools.name: arena_place_order
tools.description: Submit a limit/market/pegged/IOC/FOK/PostOnly/reduce-only order using exact USD/base or fixed-point tick/lot units over HTTP or 64B TCP wire.

tools.name: arena_replace_two_sided_quote
tools.description: Atomically replace both resting Bid and Ask quotes on a market via HTTP POST /quote or 64-byte TCP TwoSidedQuoteReplace.

tools.name: arena_modify_order
tools.description: Modify an existing resting order price and/or quantity with optional FIFO keep_priority.

tools.name: arena_cancel_orders
tools.description: Cancel a specific resting order by order_id or batch-cancel orders by market, side, client_tag_filter, or market_bitmask.

tools.name: arena_execute_atomic_basket
tools.description: Execute an all-or-nothing 2..4-leg atomic cross-market basket / spread trade via POST /basket.

tools.name: arena_portfolio_delta_hedge
tools.description: Execute a 1-frame Jacobian residual delta-neutralizing hedge via POST /auto_delta_hedge.

tools.name: arena_request_withdrawal
tools.description: Request an off-chain debit + operator-signed ARENA_WITHDRAW_V1_4 voucher (blocked unless --allow-withdrawals is explicitly enabled).

tools.name: arena_subscribe_express_port
tools.description: Purchase or extend a Native Colocation Express Port lease (epochs) for priority wire tie-break and max Core 1 ingress batching.

tools.name: arena_preview_order
tools.description: Stateless dry-run order simulation via POST /order/preview (zero WAL, L3 book, or balance mutation). Returns estimated fills, resting lots, net fee/rebate, and pre/post Eigen-SPAN IMR/MMR/free margin.

tools.name: arena_flash_arbitrage
tools.description: Execute zero-pre-margin intra-tick atomic Flash Arbitrage (mint+sell or buy+burn/redeem) on a Bonding-Curve Spot or BoundedClaim market via POST /flash_arb or 64B TCP wire.

tools.name: arena_auto_liquidate
tools.description: Execute an autonomous zero-capital liquidation & backstop bounty sweep across underwater accounts via POST /auto_liquidate.

tools.name: arena_onboard_and_deposit
tools.description: Self-service AI agent onboarding: logs in or generates an ephemeral EIP-191 wallet, optionally requests testnet collateral from POST /faucet, and optionally deposits ERC-20 margin on-chain into Clearinghouse.

http.description: Zero-install hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint for public read-only market data, L2/L3 orderbooks, OHLCV candles, Gladiator Leaderboard, ECDSA ledger-tip verification, and stateless order previews (no API key required).

uvx.description: Run the full MCP gateway locally over stdio via uvx against the public Base Sepolia testnet (https://testnet.feraterra.app).

examples.title: Inspect BTC perpetual orderbook and preview a limit order
examples.description: Fetch live L2 orderbook depth and run a stateless margin simulation with zero ledger mutation
examples.prompt: Fetch the top 10 levels of the BTC/USD:USD orderbook on FeraTerra and preview a post-only limit buy of 0.05 BTC at best bid.

examples.title: Check Gladiator Leaderboard and verify ledger-tip solvency
examples.description: Query top trading accounts by equity and verify the operator ECDSA ledger signature
examples.prompt: Show the top 10 accounts on the FeraTerra Gladiator Leaderboard sorted by equity and verify the current sovereign ledger tip signature.
